fiber_turns_u_kind: given (manual, Fig. 1 caption: 13 +- 1). Not stated whether a standard uncertainty or a bound; the analysis treats it as a standard uncertainty
loop_radius_u_kind: given (manual, Fig. 1 caption: 57.0 +- 0.5 cm). Kind not stated; treated as a standard uncertainty
wavelength_note: 640 nm as given in the manual and the preparation sheet. No tolerance was given and the laser model was not recorded
fiber: Corning SMF-28e+ (datasheet printed in the manual; the manual's text says SMF-28e)
camera_image: 1920 x 1080 RGBA PNG, 8 bits per channel; only the red channel carries light (maximum 239 of 255)
stopwatch_display_resolution_source: every turn time in Rotation calibration.csv has two decimals
timing_method: lap splits: one button press per turn, consecutive turns
motor_setting_resolution_source: settings S recorded with two decimals
note: null means unknown, never zero. Unknown inputs are reported as missing in calculate.txt and are not added to any uncertainty.
